declarations.docstring: Under the displayed matrix and quiver hypotheses, there exists an auxiliary representation whose vertexwise dimensions are the prescribed nonnegative integers.
For a selected finite index, there exists an auxiliary quiver representation whose vertexwise dimensions equal the displayed coordinate function.
An auxiliary quiver representation over a commutative semiring associated with a selected vertex.
Every vertex module of the auxiliary representation is finite over the coefficient semiring.
Every vertex module of the auxiliary representation is free over the coefficient semiring.
